findings: BLOCKER: Oracle read-only behavior is not established. Its ordinary SDK client accepts query delivery manifests and schedules delivery-report mutations to /m/<mutation>. The receipt-enabled history query has no read-only transport restriction. Closing afterward does not prevent reports during pagination.

BLOCKER: Observation persistence gates product writes. saveJournal chains Storage.setItem, and onSend awaits journalChain before uploading or submitting the message. A journal failure prevents submission and leaves subsequent journal writes chained to rejection. These hooks are not passive.
Bob authentication uses a fresh password login per invocation, with no signup fallback for the oracle, administrator credentials, Alice cache, or private-store reads.
Oracle follows next cursors to exhaustion, appends every occurrence, reverses the complete descending traversal, and emits server ordinal/message-ID tuples and receipt values without outcome flags.

Under the fixed environment, app and web exports use CLIQUE_NATIVE_ORIGIN through Expo environment inlining; seed and oracle use the operator's matching stdin origin. SNAPBACK4_BIN is unset, and the installed published platform package precedes SDK checkout fallbacks. No builder-authored binary substitution was found.
The Snapback backend wrapper supervises foreground children, forwards termination, and uses the supplied store root and origin. The Convex-specific launcher requirement is inapplicable.

Preparation and build contain no app, simulator, or server launch. With the supplied nonempty arguments, xcodebuild uses Release, /tmp/clique-native-pilot-snapback4-hrrz2ugo/DerivedData, and platform=iOS Simulator,id=3D325BD4-FD16-4A94-AA74-9F5CF1F8E48B. Package and lockfile pins match the required versions.

Initial generated autolinking metadata still references the pre-relocation lane. Preparation invokes prebuild and pod install; the prepared-source audit must verify regenerated inputs and build phases resolve exclusively to this custody source.
Source selectors preserve opaque conversation/message identities and independent body/receipt descendants. This audit establishes no native-tree, behavioral, or pixel proof.
